title: Add a widget showcase to the documentation
body:
The new v2 documentation keep and enhance most aspects of the previous aspects of the previous documentation. However it does not contain a page where we can see all the widgets in a single glance like we could in the previous documentation: discoverability of widgets is less easy.

## Proposal

Add a page where all the widgets are rendered. This page will be underneath the introduction page and before the widgets link (in the sidebar).
